text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The documents don't state that the public launch has taken place; they give only planned or target dates, and they disagree on which date applies.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states that the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s3","quote":"the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown lists the public launch as March 15, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"Public launch | March 15, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Project Overview Document gives a planned launch date of March 15, 2027.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Planned Launch Date: March 15, 2027"}]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Public launch date","claim_indexes":[1,2,3]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
